title: Acquisition and anomaly detection
newDevice: The acquisition interval and anomaly thresholds can be set after the device is saved; adjust them later from Connection settings on the home page. You can choose the acquisition optimization profile now.
unavailable: This device's acquisition settings could not be read, so they cannot be edited here. Close and reopen Connection settings; if this persists, check that the backend version supports acquisition settings.

hints.autoInterval: Stretches the effective interval when scans overrun, then steps back to the configured value.
hints.stale: Leave empty for the default: interval x5, at least 10 seconds.
hints.staleSaved: A custom value is saved; it cannot be reset to the default yet, only changed to another value above 0 ms.
hints.profile: Writes only the acquisition declaration in the connection settings; undeclared always uses safe contiguous reads.
hints.randomPoints: Defaults to the protocol limit {{limit}}; it can only be lowered.

profiles.unrecognized: Current setting {{profile}} (not offered for this protocol)

modbusNote: Modbus automatically merges blocks of contiguous addresses into one read; no random read profile is offered.

errors.intervalRange: Enter a whole number of milliseconds from {{min}} to {{max}}.
errors.staleInvalid: Enter a whole number of milliseconds above 0, or leave empty for the default.
errors.staleRequired: A saved stale threshold cannot be cleared back to the default; enter a whole number of milliseconds above 0.
errors.frozenInvalid: Enter a whole number of milliseconds, 0 or more (0 disables it).
errors.randomRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{limit}}.
errors.fx5Route: The FX5 CPU profile only applies to the own-station route: network 0, PC 0 or 255, I/O 0 or 1023, station 0. Choose another profile or change the route.

runtime.title: Running acquisition interval
runtime.unavailable: The running acquisition interval cannot be read right now; settings can still be saved. Reopen later to check it.
runtime.notRunning: This device is not collecting right now, so there is no effective interval.
runtime.stretched: Automatic adjustment has stretched the effective interval

scatteredRange.mcRuleNote: MC: 16-bit and 32-bit items count 1 point each; 64-bit items count 4 points; bit items share 1 point per aligned 16-point unit.
scatteredRange.fatekRuleNote: FATEK: 16-bit items count 1 point; 32-bit items count 2 points; 64-bit items count 4 points.
scatteredRange.corruptItemsError: The saved scattered address items could not be read. Add or edit the address items below and save again to repair this range.
scatteredRange.emptyItemsError: Add at least one scattered address item before saving.
scatteredRange.warningNearLimit: Random point usage has reached 90% or more of the single-request limit ({{used}} / {{limit}}). Adding more items may split acquisition into multiple requests.
scatteredRange.overLimitSplit: Random point usage ({{used}} / {{limit}}) exceeds the single-request limit. Saving is allowed; acquisition will automatically split into multiple requests.

disabledReasons.no_device: The device's connection settings are not available yet (no device is selected, or the workspace database is not configured), so scattered address support cannot be determined.
disabledReasons.protocol_not_supported: Scattered address mode is unavailable for Modbus; Modbus merges contiguous blocks automatically.
disabledReasons.profile_not_enabled: Scattered address mode requires a random-enabled acquisition profile ({{profile}} only supports contiguous reads). Enable a random profile in Connection settings first.

itemErrors.invalid_address: Address format is invalid for this protocol.
itemErrors.unsupported_string: String items are not supported in scattered address mode.
itemErrors.bit_requires_bool: Bit area addresses must use the bool data type.
itemErrors.overlap: Overlaps with address {{address}} in this range.
